body: Founder's first real playtest of the teleport found three real bugs, all fixed: (1) fell off/floating in the air -- movement clamped to Town's own ~57-unit footprint even inside the real ~8-unit dfzone mesh, same failure class as the earlier Town movement-bounds bug; new town_move_half_extent() picks the right bound for whichever ground is actually rendered. (2) zone felt too small relative to the avatar -- TERRAIN_TEST_CELL_SIZE tripled 1.0->3.0, tripling the physical footprint without touching the fixed 16x16 heightmap resolution; terrain_test_offset_x's spacing scales with it so F10 debug patches can't overlap. (3) hard to trigger the gate -- click required landing inside the building's tiny ~5-unit visual box; now checks the real 12-unit telecrystal radius against the gate's own position instead, ~25x more click-tolerant. Live-verified: screenshotted the larger footprint, directly exercised town_move_half_extent() confirming a runaway target position clamps correctly to the new bound. go vet/go test ./... and a direct gcc client build both clean. GoblinFoxDragon 8dddccb.
title: Playtest fixes: fell off zone, too small, hard to trigger Dragon Gate
